## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.4] - 2026-11-09

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0-alpha.3...v2.0.0-alpha.4](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/compare/v2.0.0-alpha.3...v2.0.0-alpha.4)

**发布范围**

- ACP 2.0 Alpha 维护更新，整理 hooks 代码结构并明确后续 V2 集成边界，通过 GitHub Release 和 npm `alpha` 渠道分发。

**功能优化**

- 将 hooks 按 system、messages、command、text 和 event 职责拆分，保留统一入口和现有处理逻辑，便于独立维护各类 handler。
- 补充 hook 回归测试，并记录 V2 宿主集成层与业务能力模块的职责边界。hooks 迁入 `src/v2/` 留待后续轮次完成。

**兼容性与升级前置条件**

- 要求 **OpenCode >=2.1.4 且 <3**。
- 本次更新不修改公开 API、依赖、配置或持久化状态格式，不改变 message refs 和 compression block IDs。

**已知问题**

- 本次结构调整不修复长历史会话的请求前等待问题，见 [#34](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/34)。

---

## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.4] - 2026-11-09

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0-alpha.3...v2.0.0-alpha.4](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/compare/v2.0.0-alpha.3...v2.0.0-alpha.4)

**Release scope**

- An ACP 2.0 Alpha maintenance update organizing hook implementations and defining the target V2 integration boundary, distributed through GitHub Release and the npm `alpha` channel.

**Improvements**

- Separate hook implementations by system, messages, command, text, and event responsibilities while retaining a single entry point and existing processing logic.
- Add hook regression tests and document the boundary between V2 host integration and ACP capabilities. Relocating hooks into `src/v2/` remains separate follow-up work.

**Compatibility and upgrade prerequisites**

- Requires **OpenCode >=2.1.4 and <3**.
- This update does not change public APIs, dependencies, configuration, persisted state formats, message refs, or compression block IDs.

**Known issues**

- This structural update does not fix pre-request delays in long-history sessions. See [#34](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/34).

## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.3] - 2026-11-02

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0-alpha.2...v2.0.0-alpha.3](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/compare/v2.0.0-alpha.2...v2.0.0-alpha.3)

**发布范围**

- ACP 2.0 Alpha 更新，新增可长期保留的上下文处理诊断机制，通过 GitHub Release 和 npm `alpha` 渠道分发。

**新增功能**

- 在现有 daily log 中记录结构化请求摘要，包含会话与请求标识、处理结果、总耗时、分阶段耗时及消息和压缩块数量，便于关联慢请求和失败位置。
- 提供仓库内只读日志汇总工具，支持按会话筛选、重复记录去重，以及 P50、P95、最大耗时和阶段热点统计。该工具不包含在 npm 包中。

**缺陷修复**

- 日志时间戳改为在调用时捕获，避免后续同步处理延迟时间戳，影响排查判断。

**兼容性与升级前置条件**

- 要求 **OpenCode >=2.1.4 且 <3**。
- 无新增配置字段，不改变压缩行为或持久化状态格式；继续使用现有 `logLevel` 控制记录范围。
- `info` 记录请求完成摘要；`debug` 额外记录开始与阶段轨迹。现有 debug 内容快照可能包含敏感信息，共享前请检查。

**已知问题**

- 本版本提供排查能力，尚未修复长历史会话的请求前等待问题，见 [#34](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/34)。
- 阶段耗时是经过时间，不代表独占 CPU 耗时；父子处理链存在重叠，不能相加。进程崩溃、卡死或日志写入失败时可能缺少完成记录。

---

## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.3] - 2026-11-02

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0-alpha.2...v2.0.0-alpha.3](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/compare/v2.0.0-alpha.2...v2.0.0-alpha.3)

**Release scope**

- An ACP 2.0 Alpha update introducing persistent context-processing diagnostics, distributed through GitHub Release and the npm `alpha` channel.

**New features**

- Record structured request summaries in the existing daily log, including session and trace IDs, outcomes, total and per-stage durations, and message and compression-block counts.
- Add a read-only repository tool for session filtering, deduplication, P50/P95/maximum durations, and stage hotspot summaries. The tool is not included in the npm package.

**Fixes**

- Capture log timestamps at invocation time so subsequent synchronous work does not delay timestamps and mislead investigations.

**Compatibility and upgrade prerequisites**

- Requires **OpenCode >=2.1.4 and <3**.
- No new configuration fields or changes to compression behavior or persisted state formats. Diagnostics use the existing `logLevel`.
- `info` records completion summaries; `debug` adds request-start and stage breadcrumbs. Existing debug content snapshots may contain sensitive information; review logs before sharing.

**Known issues**

- This release adds diagnostic capabilities; it does not fix pre-request delays in long-history sessions. See [#34](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/34).
- Stage durations measure elapsed time, not exclusive CPU usage. Parent and child lanes overlap and must not be added together. Crashes, hangs, or log-write failures may leave no completion record.

## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.2] - 2026-10-31

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0-alpha.1...v2.0.0-alpha.2](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/compare/v2.0.0-alpha.1...v2.0.0-alpha.2)

**发布范围**

- ACP 2.0 Alpha 渠道更新，仅支持 OpenCode V2。
- 通过 GitHub Release 和 npm 包 `@infituit/opencode-acp` 分发；本版本更新 npm `alpha` 渠道，不更新 `latest`。

**功能优化**

- 移除 billion-context 环境检测及自动避让逻辑。ACP 不再因相关环境标记而跳过初始化、上下文处理或拒绝工具调用。
- 发布流程将 GitHub Release 的预构建安装包直接发布到 npm，npm 安装无需从 Git 源码构建。
- 精简使用文档，明确配置加载顺序、工具保护、质量门控和插件维护范围。

**缺陷修复**

- 将自动更新的目标包名改为 `@infituit/opencode-acp`，与本项目实际发布的 npm 包保持一致。

**兼容性与升级前置条件**

- 要求 **OpenCode >=2.1.4 且 <3**，不支持 OpenCode 1.x。
- 安装或切换来源前移除已有的 ACP npm、Git 或本地插件项，避免重复加载；无 scope 的 `opencode-acp` 不是本项目发布的包。
- 禁用 OpenCode 内置自动压缩。不要依赖 ACP 自动避让 billion-context；如同时使用其他上下文压缩机制，请自行禁用其中一方，避免重复处理。
- 本次未变更 ACP 配置字段或持久化格式。首次从 V1 升级时，请备份旧状态并新建会话；复制 V1 JSON 状态文件不会迁移会话或压缩块。

**已知问题**

- 长历史会话的 V2 上下文处理仍可能在模型请求发送前增加明显等待；已有约 8–9 秒及 36.7 秒的报告，尚未修复，见 [#34](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/34)。

**安装**

```bash
opencode plugin add @infituit/opencode-acp@2.0.0-alpha.2
```

也可使用 `@alpha` 跟随 Alpha 渠道。安装后执行 `/reload`，开启新会话并使用 `/acp` 确认插件可用。

---

## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.2] - 2026-10-31

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0-alpha.1...v2.0.0-alpha.2](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/compare/v2.0.0-alpha.1...v2.0.0-alpha.2)

**Release scope**

- An update to the ACP 2.0 Alpha channel, supporting OpenCode V2 only.
- Distributed through GitHub Release and the npm package `@infituit/opencode-acp`. This version updates the npm `alpha` channel without updating `latest`.

**Improvements**

- Remove billion-context environment detection and automatic yielding. ACP no longer skips initialization, bypasses context processing, or rejects tool calls because of those environment markers.
- Publish the prebuilt GitHub Release package directly to npm. Installing from npm does not require a Git source build.
- Simplify usage documentation and clarify configuration loading, tool protection, quality gates, and the scope of plugin maintenance.

**Fixes**

- Change the automatic update target to `@infituit/opencode-acp`, matching the npm package published by this project.

**Compatibility and upgrade prerequisites**

- Requires **OpenCode >=2.1.4 and <3**; OpenCode 1.x is not supported.
- Remove existing ACP npm, Git, or local plugin entries before installing or switching sources to avoid duplicate loading. The unscoped `opencode-acp` package is not published by this project.
- Disable OpenCode's built-in automatic compaction. Do not rely on ACP to yield automatically to billion-context; if another context compression mechanism is enabled, disable one of them to avoid duplicate processing.
- This release does not change ACP configuration fields or the persisted state format. When upgrading from V1, back up existing state and start a new session; copying V1 JSON state files does not migrate sessions or compression blocks.

**Known issues**

- V2 context processing in long-history sessions can still introduce noticeable delays before a model request is sent. Delays of approximately 8–9 seconds and 36.7 seconds have been reported and remain unresolved; see [#34](https://github.com/infituit/opencode-acp/issues/34).

**Installation**

```bash
opencode plugin add @infituit/opencode-acp@2.0.0-alpha.2
```

Alternatively, use `@alpha` to follow the Alpha channel. Run `/reload` after installation, start a new session, and use `/acp` to confirm the plugin is available.

## [Version: v2.0.0-alpha.1] - 2026-10-28

> 本版本为 Alpha 预发布，仅支持 OpenCode V2。升级前请备份现有状态，并移除旧的 ACP 插件配置。

**发布范围**

- ACP 2.0 的首个 Alpha，包含当前 `master` 上的 OpenCode V2 插件实现。
- 仅通过 GitHub 分发，不发布到 npm；`opencode-acp@stable` 和 `opencode-acp@latest` 不会安装本版本。

**主要变更**

- 将插件入口和运行时集成迁移到 OpenCode V2 插件 API。
- 接入 V2 宿主的工具、`/acp` 命令、会话 hooks、事件和原生插件存储。
- 转换 V2 消息，接入 ACP 的压缩与恢复流程。
- 保留模型驱动的三级压缩、解压、上下文状态查看和压缩内容搜索。

**兼容性与升级前置条件**

- 要求 **OpenCode >=2.1.4 且 <3**，不支持 OpenCode 1.x。
- 安装需要 Git 和 Node.js/npm，Git 安装过程会构建插件。
- 安装前移除旧的 npm 或本地 ACP 插件项，避免重复加载。
- 默认使用 OpenCode 原生插件存储。请备份旧状态并新建会话；复制 V1 JSON 状态文件不会迁移会话或压缩块。

**安装**

```bash
opencode plugin add github:infituit/opencode-acp#v2.0.0-alpha.1
```

安装后执行 `/reload`，开启新会话并使用 `/acp` 确认插件可用。
